title.narrative: Feasibility study for BiOES in the North-East Tobago Biosphere Reserve

description.narrative: This project covers the feasibility study of a large-scale project to create community-based marine and coastal Biosphere Reserve observatories (UNESCO Biosphere Observatories for Ocean Ecosystem Sustainability - BiOES), i.e. permanent data-collection, monitoring and analysis platforms or systems that provide key information and insights for area planning and management. These observatories will focus on data collection, knowledge generation, and analyses addressing gaps that prevent the development and implementation of marine spatial planning (MSP) that helps allocating the distribution of human activities in marine areas to achieve ecological, economic and social objectives.
